name: v18.1.3
body:
## [18.1.3](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.1.2...v18.1.3) (2026-11-02)


### Bug Fixes

* allow trailing tabs after a setext heading underline ([#4152](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4152)) ([1f1b480](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1f1b480a29644a26e70ad63cd45343e439fb12e9))
* avoid quadratic scan for unmatched emphasis delimiters ([#4103](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4103)) ([eab1e48](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/eab1e483fe88e559288d3003d493bbc0ec4ecf53)), closes [#4099](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4099)
* await promise arrays from walkTokens extensions ([#4153](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4153)) ([c38704c](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/c38704c2faa07f9d68b278133ec668039d58149b))
* **cli:** honor defaults and config when outputting tokens ([#4146](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4146)) ([9470e8f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/9470e8f719d6b276065e277de5d9f8bca7c35c4a))
* collapse internal whitespace when normalizing link labels ([#4157](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4157)) ([02c73e8](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/02c73e8e659d369f4baba41903be3ddde128f15c))
* do not allow a blank line inside a link reference definition label ([#4165](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4165)) ([f3d21af](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/f3d21af0706fd6f10998e838e0841c39603689cc))
* don't treat an escaped ) or quote as an inline link or title closer ([#4151](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4151)) ([9cb84e0](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/9cb84e07d18833a241f3df13d7419596f5b203ff))
* end a list item before a lazy line after an html block ([#4159](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4159)) ([7ba42f4](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7ba42f445cd88286dbad4e4104e6b3842ed814b5))
* end blockquote before a lazy line after a table ([#4161](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4161)) ([e7dcf52](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e7dcf52ddbf88171e630ec1b88d8242d67b29e0b))
* isolate extension names from Object.prototype ([#4177](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4177)) ([5cb03bd](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/5cb03bd9a293976c8dd3099274cff161b08f5cb0))
* keep a block quote open after a lazy line in a nested block quote ([#4175](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4175)) ([1d7272f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1d7272f9ca02cdef3fb2ad061fa4da38b8978661))
* only close a code fence with the opening fence character ([#4164](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4164)) ([1d4d8fe](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1d4d8fe6f5ed2a4ead1a75bf67627318ca92115a))
* preserve zero-valued custom renderer results ([#4162](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4162)) ([e43ceef](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e43ceef44a981a620072252c021f43f4e5395fc4))
* recognize task list items when a tab follows the checkbox ([#4163](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4163)) ([64a299d](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/64a299def97ab8d2aa0c92458585ee894c247a5d))
* start a GFM www autolink only at a word boundary ([#4166](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4166)) ([84beefb](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/84beefb3eb24dbf25c526467a2a3906b9afe11e8))


### Performance Improvements

* fix backtracking in padantic html ([#4173](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4173)) ([2d4a23c](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/2d4a23c50e5c4fe64de67762d19a0c9741a811d4))
